benefits.name: Fine Hotels + Resorts / The Hotel Collection Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit toward prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection bookings made through American Express Travel.

eligibleMerchants: Fine Hotels + Resorts via Amex Travel
The Hotel Collection via Amex Travel

benefits.terms: Up to $300 per half-year period ($600/year total). The Hotel Collection requires a minimum 2-night prepaid stay. No enrollment required.

benefits.name: Airline Fee Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for incidental fees (checked bags, seat selection, in-flight refreshments, etc.) on one airline selected annually.
benefits.terms: Must select one qualifying airline per calendar year via the Amex account. Covers incidental fees only, not the ticket cost.

benefits.name: U.S. Wireless Service Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit for purchases made directly with a U.S. wireless telephone service provider.
benefits.terms: Up to $10/month ($120/year total). Enrollment required. One credit per month per card account regardless of purchase count.

benefits.name: Dell Credit
benefits.description: Statement credits for U.S. purchases made directly with Dell Technologies, plus a bonus credit after meeting a spend threshold.
benefits.terms: $150 in statement credits per calendar year, plus an additional $1,000 statement credit after spending $5,000 or more with Dell in the same calendar year. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Adobe Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit after spending on Adobe purchases directly with Adobe.
benefits.terms: $250 statement credit after spending $600 or more on U.S. purchases directly with Adobe per calendar year. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Indeed Credit
benefits.description: Quarterly statement credit for purchases made at Indeed.com.
benefits.terms: Up to $90 per quarter ($360/year total). Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Hilton Credit
benefits.description: Quarterly statement credit for purchases made directly with Hilton.
benefits.terms: Up to $50 per quarter ($200/year total). Requires Hilton for Business membership; enrollment required. Gift cards are not eligible purchases.

benefits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry (every 4 years) or TSA PreCheck (5-year membership) application fee.
benefits.terms: Global Entry credit is up to $120 (renews on the ~4-year Global Entry cycle); TSA PreCheck credit is up to $85 (5-year cycle). Modeled here on the Global Entry cadence as the more commonly chosen option.

benefits.name: Global Lounge Collection
benefits.description: Access to over 1,550 airport lounges worldwide, including Centurion Lounges, Escape Lounges, Delta Sky Club, Plaza Premium, Priority Pass, and Lufthansa lounges.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Varies by lounge network. As of July 8, 2026, Centurion Lounge guest access requires guests to be on the same flight as the cardmember; layover access is capped at 5 hours before departure. Delta Sky Club requires same-day Delta-marketed/operated flight.

benefits.terms: Priority Pass requires separate enrollment through Amex.

benefits.name: Hilton Honors Gold Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hilton Honors Gold status: room upgrades when available, 80% bonus points, food/beverage credits at eligible properties, 5th night free on award stays.
benefits.terms: Complimentary enrollment required by linking a Hilton Honors account. No stays or spending required.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including space-available room upgrades.
benefits.terms: Enrollment is automatic/complimentary via linking Marriott Bonvoy account. No stays or spending required.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement for reasonable expenses when a covered trip is delayed 6+ hours.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses when a covered trip is cancelled or interrupted.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible purchases against accidental damage or theft for 90 days from purchase.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 5 years or less by an additional year.

earningRates.terms: Flights and prepaid hotels booked on amextravel.com. No annual cap (unlike the personal Platinum card's $500,000 cap).

2x on U.S. construction material & hardware suppliers, U.S. electronic goods retailers, U.S. software & cloud system providers, U.S. shipping providers, and any purchase of $5,000+, up to a combined $2,000,000/year, then 1x. A purchase qualifying for multiple categories still only earns 2x once.
